Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh rate with a matching frame cap gives a smooth, consistent feel that suits the game's pacing; GE-Proton is recommended over default Proton for better EA launcher compatibility. Reduce Lighting and Effects first if frame rate dips in large battles.

profiles.Summary: Battlefield V is a demanding DirectX 12 title that runs on the Steam Deck via Proton with mixed results — ProtonDB reports trend toward broken, with some players achieving silver-level playability at reduced settings. The game's RDNA 2 GPU on the Deck sits roughly at minimum spec, so expect 30–40 fps only at low settings with upscaling, and online multiplayer stability may be inconsistent.
profiles.BasisNote: No working Deck-specific reports were available (ProtonDB trending borked, no guides found); profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended specs relative to Deck GPU capability and general Proton/EA game behaviour. On first launch, verify the game opens past the EA launcher, check frame rate in a single-player mission before attempting multiplayer, and drop to Max Battery settings if performance is unstable.

MaxBattery.Notes: DX11 launch option improves stability over DX12 on Proton; FSR upscaling from 960x600 helps maintain target frame rate at the cost of image clarity. Battery life is estimated — EA launcher overhead may reduce it further.

KnownIssues: EA App / Origin overlay can prevent the game from launching or cause crashes; disabling it or using launch options is often required.
Anti-cheat (Easy Anti-Cheat) may block online multiplayer on Linux/Proton, making PvP modes potentially unplayable.
Trending 'borked' on ProtonDB suggests recent updates or EA launcher changes have worsened compatibility.
DX12 mode can cause stuttering or crashes; switching to DX11 via launch options may improve stability.

MaxPerformance.Notes: 60 fps is a ceiling rather than a guarantee — expect drops into the 40s during large multiplayer engagements; if frame rate is unstable, drop the cap to 40 and lower Effects and Lighting to Low. This profile drains the battery quickly and is best for short sessions or docked play.

Optimal.Notes: A 40 Hz refresh + 40 fps cap gives perfectly smooth pacing on the OLED panel and a reasonable battery life; FSR at 1024x640 restores visual clarity without a heavy GPU cost. Shader stutter may occur in the first session but settles after the cache is built.

profiles.Summary: Battlefield V runs on Steam Deck only through Proton and is officially Unsupported, primarily because Easy Anti-Cheat blocks online multiplayer on Linux, limiting play to offline/single-player modes. The Deck's GPU sits at the PC minimum spec, so low settings with FSR upscaling are required to reach a stable 30–40 fps.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements and Steam Deck hardware capability. On first run, check frame rate in a large outdoor area and drop to the Optimal or MaxBattery profile if it dips below your target.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 with FSR enabled in the Deck overlay to recover sharpness; all settings on Low are essential to stay within the 8 W TDP envelope. If the game fails to launch, disable the EA in-game overlay in the EA App settings before starting.

KnownIssues: Easy Anti-Cheat blocks online multiplayer on Linux/Proton — the game is effectively single-player/offline only on Deck.
EA App launcher changes have caused launch failures for many users; GE-Proton and disabling the EA overlay are commonly needed workarounds.
DX12 rendering can cause heavy shader compilation stutters on first run; switching to DX11 via launch options often improves stability.
ProtonDB trending 'borked' suggests recent updates have broken launching for a significant portion of users.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Native 1280x800 at medium settings pushes the Deck to its limit; expect 40-55 fps with dips in large open areas or heavy combat — consider dropping to the Optimal profile if stuttering persists. Battery drain will be significant at 15 W TDP.
